catalog.name: entity:pos.config
catalog.description: Complete definition of entity Point of Sale Configuration (pos.config).

fields.name: name
fields.help: An internal identification of the point of sale.

fields.name: journal_id
fields.help: Accounting journal used to post POS session journal entries and POS invoice payments.

fields.name: invoice_journal_id
fields.help: Accounting journal used to create invoices.

fields.name: iface_cashdrawer
fields.help: Automatically open the cashdrawer.

fields.name: iface_electronic_scale
fields.help: Enables Electronic Scale integration.

fields.name: iface_print_via_proxy
fields.help: Bypass browser printing and prints via the hardware proxy.

fields.name: iface_scan_via_proxy
fields.help: Enable barcode scanning with a remotely connected barcode scanner and card swiping with a Vantiv card reader.

fields.name: iface_big_scrollbars
fields.help: For imprecise industrial touchscreens.

fields.name: iface_group_by_categ
fields.help: Display products grouped by categories.

fields.name: iface_print_auto
fields.help: The receipt will automatically be printed at the end of each order.

fields.name: iface_print_skip_screen
fields.help: The receipt screen will be skipped if the receipt can be printed automatically.

fields.name: iface_available_categ_ids
fields.help: The point of sale will only display products which are within one of the selected category trees. If no category is specified, all available products will be shown

fields.name: restrict_price_control
fields.help: Only users with Manager access rights for PoS app can modify the product prices on orders.

fields.name: is_margins_costs_accessible_to_every_user
fields.help: When disabled, only PoS manager can view the margin and cost of product among the Product info.

fields.name: cash_control
fields.help: Check the amount of the cashbox at opening and closing.

fields.name: set_maximum_difference
fields.help: Set a maximum difference allowed between the expected and counted money during the closing of the session.

fields.name: receipt_header
fields.help: A short text that will be inserted as a header in the printed receipt.

fields.name: receipt_footer
fields.help: A short text that will be inserted as a footer in the printed receipt.

fields.name: basic_receipt
fields.help: Print basic ticket without prices. Can be used for gifts.

fields.name: proxy_ip
fields.help: The hostname or ip address of the hardware proxy, Will be autodetected if left empty.

fields.name: uuid
fields.help: A globally unique identifier for this pos configuration, used to prevent conflicts in client-generated data.

fields.name: pricelist_id
fields.help: The pricelist used if no customer is selected or if the customer has no Sale Pricelist configured if any.

fields.name: available_pricelist_ids
fields.help: Make several pricelists available in the Point of Sale. You can also apply a pricelist to specific customers from their contact form (in Sales tab). To be valid, this pricelist must be listed here as an available pricelist. Otherwise the default pricelist will apply.

fields.name: group_pos_manager_id
fields.help: This field is there to pass the id of the pos manager group to the point of sale client.

fields.name: group_pos_user_id
fields.help: This field is there to pass the id of the pos user group to the point of sale client.

fields.name: tip_product_id
fields.help: This product is used as reference on customer receipts.

fields.name: fiscal_position_ids
fields.help: This is useful for restaurants with onsite and take-away services that imply specific tax rates.

fields.name: module_pos_avatax
fields.help: Use automatic taxes mapping with Avatax in PoS

fields.name: module_pos_hr
fields.help: Show employee login screen
fields.string: Module Point of sale Human resources
fields.full_name: Module Point of sale Human resources

fields.name: amount_authorized_diff
fields.help: This field depicts the maximum difference allowed between the ending balance and the theoretical cash when closing a session, for non-POS managers. If this maximum is reached, the user will have an error message at the closing of his session saying that he needs to contact his manager.

fields.name: other_devices
fields.help: Connect devices to your PoS without an IoT Box.

fields.name: route_id
fields.string: Spefic route for products delivered later.
fields.full_name: Spefic route for products delivered later.

fields.name: picking_policy
fields.help: If you deliver all products at once, the delivery order will be scheduled based on the greatest product lead time. Otherwise, it will be based on the shortest.

fields.name: auto_validate_terminal_payment
fields.help: Automatically validates orders paid with a payment terminal.

fields.name: show_product_images
fields.help: Show product images in the Point of Sale interface.

fields.name: show_category_images
fields.help: Show category images in the Point of Sale interface.

fields.name: note_ids
fields.help: The predefined notes of this point of sale.

fields.name: module_pos_sms
fields.help: Activate SMS feature for point_of_sale

fields.name: is_closing_entry_by_product
fields.help: Display the breakdown of sales lines by product in the automatically generated closing entry.

fields.name: order_edit_tracking
fields.help: Store edited orders in the backend

fields.name: epson_printer_ip
fields.help: Local IP address of an Epson receipt printer, or its serial number if the 'Automatic Certificate Update' option is enabled in the printer settings.

fields.name: use_fast_payment
fields.help: Enable fast payment methods to validate orders on the product screen.

fields.name: fast_payment_method_ids
fields.help: These payment methods will be available for fast payment

fields.name: iface_splitbill
fields.help: Enables Bill Splitting in the Point of Sale.

fields.name: iface_printbill
fields.help: Allows to print the Bill before payment.

fields.name: floor_ids
fields.help: The restaurant floors served by this point of sale.

fields.name: set_tip_after_payment
fields.help: Adjust the amount authorized by payment terminals to add a tip after the customers left or at the end of the day.

fields.name: crm_team_id
fields.help: This Point of sale's sales will be related to this Sales Team.

fields.name: down_payment_product_id
fields.help: This product will be used as down payment on a sale order.

fields.name: l10n_vn_pos_symbol
fields.help: This is the symbol that will be used on invoices issued from this POS.

fields.name: iface_discount
fields.help: Allow the cashier to give discounts on the whole order.

fields.name: discount_pc
fields.help: The default discount percentage when clicking on the Discount button

fields.name: discount_product_id
fields.help: The product used to apply the discount on the ticket.

fields.name: minimal_employee_ids
fields.help: If left empty, all employees can log in to PoS

fields.name: basic_employee_ids
fields.help: If left empty, all employees can log in to PoS

fields.name: advanced_employee_ids
fields.help: Employees linked to users with the PoS Manager role are automatically added to this list

fields.name: self_ordering_mode
fields.help: Choose the self ordering mode

fields.name: self_ordering_service_mode
fields.help: Choose the kiosk mode

fields.name: self_ordering_default_language_id
fields.help: Default language for the kiosk mode

fields.name: self_ordering_available_language_ids
fields.help: Languages available for the kiosk mode

fields.name: self_ordering_image_home_ids
fields.help: Image to display on the self order screen

fields.name: self_ordering_image_background_ids
fields.help: Image to be displayed in the background

fields.name: self_ordering_default_user_id
fields.help: Access rights of this user will be used when visiting self order website when no session is open.

fields.name: self_ordering_pay_after
fields.help: Choose when the customer will pay

fields.name: self_ordering_image_brand
fields.help: Image to display on the self order screen

fields.name: self_ordering_image_brand_name
fields.string: Self Order Kiosk Image Brand Name
fields.help: Name of the image to display on the self order screen
fields.full_name: Self Order Kiosk Image Brand Name

fields.name: self_order_online_payment_method_id
fields.help: The online payment method to use when a customer pays a self-order online.

fields.name: sms_receipt_template_id
fields.help: SMS will be sent to the customer based on this template

definitions.documentation:
From the res.config.settings view, changes in the x2many fields always result to an array of link commands or a single set command.
- As a result, the items that should be unlinked are not properly unlinked.
- So before doing the write, we inspect the commands to determine which records should be unlinked.
- We only care about the link command.
- We can consider set command as absolute as it will replace all.

Keep values in vals that are different than
self's values.

Open the pos interface with config_id as an extra argument.

In vanilla PoS each user can only have one active session, therefore it was not needed to pass the config_id
on opening a session. It is also possible to login to sessions created by other users.
